items.title: Richard McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: he said he wanted to, how you play with him tonight? ... So I went off and I played.

ctx.x: Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. house I was in then. So by this fella hearing me, he knew Artie Boyer, he come back asking for Artie Boyer. So my wife's aunt said, well he don't live here anymore. He said, well, I thought I heard him today when I passed here. She said, well, we didn't hear him because he hadn't been here in quite a while. She said, well, I'm sure I heard a guitar playing, somebody playing a guitar in here. Oh, she said, well, maybe you heard my niece's husband. So he said, well, is he…
